name: Marsha
bio: Archetype: Lingering Glow, Cleanse, Shield Extension. ⌽ Accumulates [Lingering Glow] stacks when [Burn] or [Halo] is inflicted. Gains bonus stacks based on the number of allies using [Lingering Glow]. Also buffs Crit DMG and increases maximum [Burn] stacks with three allies using [Lingering Glow]. ⌽ Cleanses [Control] from affected allies at turn start and grants other allies [Pardon], which nullifies the next [Control] inflicted on them. ⌽ Gains [Frontline Care] at turn start, which is consumed to cast Skill 2, generate Moxie and acquire [Pain's Response] when an ally is hit. ⌽ Skill 2 stacks shield on any existing ones and extends its duration. When actively cast, consumes [Frontline Care] to cleanse [Stats Down] and [Neg Status]. All allies start the battle with this shield. ⌽ Ultimate converts [Pain's Response] to [Discipline Forged], which buffs Crit, Incantation Might and Crit conversion for all allies.
